javaWebIntegration.legacyPolicy: Existing native data without a marker retains the old package UUID. Clearing that save drops its binding and uses a fresh UUID on next launch; shared legacy WebKit bytes are retained to protect other libraries.
remaining: Real HTTP application/plugin persistence; page-script direct file URL navigation and broader Activity replacement/recreate ordering; unprepared/loading documents. No fsync claim for system WebKit databases.

Cross-origin child frame saving is unsupported and fails closed. Synthetic lifecycle has isTrusted=false; event.waitUntil is a Husk extension. Unregistered asynchronous work and code requiring trusted browser unload are not guaranteed.
Generic Thread.interrupt and blocking-wait semantics, macOS 14 hardware, WebKit process failure recovery and network-cancellation timeouts remain unverified.
javaWebIntegration.saveStage: Host-requested close or final Activity guest finish keeps Java bridge dispatch alive, suspends media, blocks new navigation and ordinary recurring tasks, delivers synthetic lifecycle once, awaits event.waitUntil promises and same-origin child frames within six seconds, then drains immediate AppMain messages before Android destruction. Later actual unload is gated; late bridge calls and all observed save failures reject storage-closed.
javaWebIntegration.guestFinish: Opt-in AppMain callback defers final Activity/whole-stack affinity destruction to host saving and existing phase 10 teardown. Recheck after already-queued launches; preserve child results, deduplicate requests and reject Activity launches/recreate after handoff. NULL callback keeps old host behavior. Process.killProcess still fails lifecycle acknowledgement. A valid stopping event starts the existing 30-second deadline without heartbeat extensions.
javaWebIntegration.perViewDestroy: Direct WebView.destroy closes normal APIs but retains Java plugin/resource dispatch until a bounded save, JavaBridge/AppMain acknowledgement and WebKit detach. Other views continue. Whole-session preparation waits retiring views; all observed failures stay sticky. AndroidX listeners execute on AppMain before reply, and ReplyProxy can reply during preparation. Empty detach documents do not rerun application user scripts.
javaWebIntegration.navigation: Main-frame reload/back/forward and Java WebView.loadUrl wait for the old document's pagehide/unload, Java plugin calls and event.waitUntil before replacement. A successful save resets after didCommitNavigation; failure or six-second timeout cancels navigation and remains sticky through host-stop. Android asset/resource/file URLs are remapped to huskapp. The fixture verifies Java loadUrl; page-script direct file URL navigation is not separately accepted.
